armyRules.name: Thrill Seekers
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Emperor's Children^^**, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so:
- It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn
- It cannot target a unit that was the target of another unit's charge or attack this phase.

armyRules.name: Pact of Excess
armyRules.text: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select LEGIONS OF EXCESS as your Army Faction.

rule.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, if your **^^Warlord^^** is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your **^^Warlord**^^ model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

**^^Emperor's Children^^** units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle, as shown below (these are all cumulative).

1+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
3+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
5+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [^^Lethal Hits^^] and [^^Sustained Hits 1^^]] abilities.
7+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

Protection of the Dark Prince.name: PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE
Protection of the Dark Prince.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
Protection of the Dark Prince.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Protection of the Dark Prince.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Protection of the Dark Prince.flavour: On occasion, the Dark Prince may grant a boon of protection to his favoured followers in the heat of battle. Such a boon incurs a debt, one that will be paid in the fullness of time.

Unshakeable Opponents.name: UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS
Unshakeable Opponents.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
Unshakeable Opponents.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
Unshakeable Opponents.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
Unshakeable Opponents.flavour: Inured to ordinary sensations by several lifetimes of indulgence, there is little that can deter or faze the warriors of the Emperor's Children.

Embrace the Pain.name: EMBRACE THE PAIN
Embrace the Pain.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.
Embrace the Pain.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
Embrace the Pain.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
Embrace the Pain.flavour: The Emperor’s Children revel in every sensation - even ones that would slay lesser mortals outright.

Martial Perfection.name: MARTIAL PERFECTION
Martial Perfection.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Martial Perfection.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Martial Perfection.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Martial Perfection.flavour: The Emperor’s Children find stimulation in excess, be it brutally shocking acts of violence or gratuitous displays of martial prowess.

Unbound Arrogance.name: UNBOUND ARROGANCE
Unbound Arrogance.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Unbound Arrogance.effect: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
Unbound Arrogance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Unbound Arrogance.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Unbound Arrogance.flavour: The hubris of the Emperor’s Children is both their greatest strength and their biggest weakness.

Armour of Abhorrence.name: ARMOUR OF ABHORRENCE
Armour of Abhorrence.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armour of Abhorrence.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armour of Abhorrence.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Armour of Abhorrence.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Armour of Abhorrence.flavour: The abhorrent contempt that the Emperor’s Children possess, combined with their combat-stimmed physiologies, makes them unyielding foes to face.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
enhancements.text: The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. if that test is passed, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).

enhancements.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
enhancements.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked: if failed, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
enhancements.text: Once per turn, after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

rule.name: Daemonic Empowerment
rule.text:
- While an ^^**Emperor's Children^^** unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly ^^**Legions of Excess**^^ units, it is Empowered.
- While a ^^**Legions of Excess**^^ unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly  ^^**Emperor's Children^^** units, it is Empowered.

While a unit from your army is Empowered, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [^^Sustained Hits 1^^] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Sustained by Agony.name: SUSTAINED BY AGONY
Sustained by Agony.when: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Sustained by Agony.effect: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.
Sustained by Agony.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.
Sustained by Agony.flavour: Slaaneshi daemons feed upon the emotions of others, with agony a particular delicacy.

Ecstatic Slaughter.name: ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER
Ecstatic Slaughter.when: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Ecstatic Slaughter.target: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Ecstatic Slaughter.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.
Ecstatic Slaughter.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.
Ecstatic Slaughter.flavour: As the violence intensifies, so does the ecstasy of battle empower daemon and mortal alike.

Violent Crescendo.name: VIOLENT CRESCENDO
Violent Crescendo.target: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Violent Crescendo.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
Violent Crescendo.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
Violent Crescendo.flavour: In the final act of the battle, the followers of Slaanesh descend to slaughter the remaining foes.

Sycophantic Surge.name: SYCOPHANTIC SURGE
Sycophantic Surge.target: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
Sycophantic Surge.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.
Sycophantic Surge.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.
Sycophantic Surge.flavour: The daemons of Slaanesh care naught for mortals but strive to earn the approval of their Dark Prince.

Uncanny Reactions.name: UNCANNY REACTIONS
Uncanny Reactions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Uncanny Reactions.target: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Uncanny Reactions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Uncanny Reactions.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Uncanny Reactions.flavour: Those who have earned the favour of their Dark Prince may be granted a sliver of his grace.

Dark Apparitions.name: DARK APPARITIONS
Dark Apparitions.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Dark Apparitions.target: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Dark Apparitions.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units.
Dark Apparitions.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units.
Dark Apparitions.flavour: The daemons of Slaanesh are not bound by the laws of reality, fading in and out of existence at will.

enhancements.name: Empyric Suffusion
enhancements.text: When you target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Dark Blessings
enhancements.text: Once per battle, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Possessed Blade
enhancements.text: At the start of the battle, select one melee weapon equipped by the bearer; add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon. In addition, each time the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, when resolving those attacks add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and that weapon has the [^^Devastating Wounds^^] and [^^Hazardous^^] abilities.

enhancements.name: Warp Walker
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer's unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Movement characteristic of models in that unit. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

rule.name: Mechanised Murder
rule.text: Each time an ^^**Emperor's Children^^** model from your army makes an attack, if it is a ^^**Transport^^** model or disembarked from a ^^**Transport^^** this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Onto the Next.name: ONTO THE NEXT
Onto the Next.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
Onto the Next.effect: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
Onto the Next.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.

EFFECT: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
Onto the Next.flavour: The fleeting obsessions of the Emperor's Children cause them always to seek fresh targets.

Advance and Claim.name: ADVANCE AND CLAIM
Advance and Claim.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
Advance and Claim.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Advance and Claim.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Advance and Claim.flavour: The Emperor's Children send forth their front-line troops in swift vehicles to seize ground rapidly.

Dynamic Breakthrough.name: DYNAMIC BREAKTHROUGH
Dynamic Breakthrough.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Dynamic Breakthrough.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
Dynamic Breakthrough.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
Dynamic Breakthrough.flavour: Relying upon shock, awe and daemonically enhanced vehicles, the Emperor's Children drive through the enemy lines to outflank the enemy.

Ceaseless Onslaught.name: CEASELESS ONSLAUGHT
Ceaseless Onslaught.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.
Ceaseless Onslaught.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
Ceaseless Onslaught.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.

EFFECT: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
Ceaseless Onslaught.flavour: Cocktails of combat stimms and a blazing murderlust drive the warriors of the Emperor’s Children forward at breakneck speed.

Reactive Disembarkation.name: REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION
Reactive Disembarkation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Reactive Disembarkation.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reactive Disembarkation.effect: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Reactive Disembarkation.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Reactive Disembarkation.flavour: As their transports come underfire, the Emperor’s Children disembark and take the fight to the foe with boltgun and sword.

Outflanking Strike.name: OUTFLANKING STRIKE
Outflanking Strike.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Outflanking Strike.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.
Outflanking Strike.effect: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Outflanking Strike.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.

EFFECT: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Outflanking Strike.flavour: The Emperor’s Children utilise their infantry to pin the enemy down whilst further transports seek to outflank the foe and deploy troops behind.

enhancements.name: Sublime Presence
enhancements.text: Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly **^^Emperor's Children Transport**^^ that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that **^^Transport**^^ on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Spearhead Striker
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer disembarks from a **^^Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit and enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Accomplished Tactician
enhancements.text: Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot, you can select one friendly **^^Emperor's Children**^^ unit within 9" of the bearer that was hit by one or more of those attacks, then select one friendly **^^Transport**^^ that unit is wholly within 6" of and is able to embark within. That **^^Emperor's Children**^^ unit can embark in that **^^Transport**^^.

enhancements.name: Heretek Adept
enhancements.text: Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly **^^Emperor's Children Vehicle**^^ model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: - Sublime Prescience
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that TRANSPORT on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

rule.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
rule.text:
Each time an ^^**Emperor's Children**^^ unit from your army is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one of the abilities below. While resolving those attacks, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the ability:
- [^^Lethal Hits^^]
- [^^Sustained Hits 1^^]

Deft Parry.name: DEFT PARRY
Deft Parry.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Deft Parry.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Deft Parry.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Deft Parry.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Deft Parry.flavour: Bedazzled by these warriors’ weaving swordsmanship and hypnotic aura, foes cannot land a telling blow upon them.

Death Ecstasy.name: DEATH ECSTASY
Death Ecstasy.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Death Ecstasy.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Death Ecstasy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Death Ecstasy.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Death Ecstasy.flavour: Death is but another thrilling experience and the Emperor's Children are loath to deny the enemy such ecstatic sensation.

Incessant Violence.name: INCESSANT VIOLENCE
Incessant Violence.when: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.
Incessant Violence.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Incessant Violence.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Incessant Violence.flavour: Caught up in the joyful exhilaration of violent excess, the momentum of the Emperor's Children is almost impossible to halt.

Cruel Bladesman.name: CRUEL BLADESMAN
Cruel Bladesman.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Cruel Bladesman.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Cruel Bladesman.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Cruel Bladesman.flavour: Fulgrim’s scions are renowned for their bladecraft, toying with their inferiors while preparing an exquisite, penetrating thrust.

Terrifying Spectacle.name: TERRIFYING SPECTACLE
Terrifying Spectacle.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
Terrifying Spectacle.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
Terrifying Spectacle.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Cut Down the Weak.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
Cut Down the Weak.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select a VEHICLE if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
Cut Down the Weak.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.
Cut Down the Weak.text:

Cut Down the Weak.flavour: Contempt for lesser warriors drives the Emperor's Children in their punishing reprisals.

You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do: 
- That use is -1 CP. 
- That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Blinding Speed
enhancements.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does so, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Distortion
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Attacks and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Rise to the Challenge
enhancements.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer can fight one additional time. When doing so, you can select one ability using the Exquisite Swordsmanship Detachment rule to apply to those attacks.

rule.name: Sensational Performance
rule.text:
^^**Emperor’s Children^^** units from your army have the following ability: 
**Sensational Performance**: Each time this unit is selected to fight, if this unit made a Charge move this turn, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase: 
- This unit cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn. 
- This unit cannot target a unit that was the target of another unit’s attack this phase. 
- Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons by 1.

rule.name: Master of the Pageant
rule.text: Once per battle round, when you target a ^^**Fulgrim^^** unit from your army with the Sinuous Breach or Prideful Superiority Stratagem, you can reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

Contemptuous Disregard.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
Contemptuous Disregard.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Contemptuous Disregard.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
Contemptuous Disregard.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Contemptuous Disregard.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

Contemptuous Disregard.flavour: With cocktails of resilience-enhancing stimms or armour inlaid with forbidden runes of warding, the Emperor’s Children sneeringly disregard even powerful blows.

Prideful Superiority.name: PRIDEFUL SUPERIORITY
Prideful Superiority.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Prideful Superiority.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

WHEN: Fight phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Prideful Superiority.flavour: The chance to ostentatiously humble the foe’s champions and prove them worthless rivals is a lure few Emperor’s Children can resist.

Sinuous Breach.name: SINUOUS BREACH
Sinuous Breach.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Sinuous Breach.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

Sinuous Breach.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
Sinuous Breach.flavour: The power of Slaanesh is an undulating and writhing thing, and his daemonic servants can mould their forms to slither over and through any obstacle.

Close-Quarters Excruciation.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS EXCRUCIATION
Close-Quarters Excruciation.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Close-Quarters Excruciation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
Close-Quarters Excruciation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
Close-Quarters Excruciation.flavour: At short range, the Emperor’s Children eagerly target weak points in their enemies, exulting over every cry of pain they elicit.

Euphoric Inspiration.name: EUPHORIC INSPIRATION
Euphoric Inspiration.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army.
Euphoric Inspiration.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units within 6" of your unit.
Euphoric Inspiration.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units within 6" of your unit.
Euphoric Inspiration.flavour: Those with the Dark Prince’s blessings inspire euphoric floods of battle-lust in the Emperor’s Children, who power towards the foe with screams of murderous ecstasy.

Catalytic Stimulus.name: CATALYTIC STIMULUS
Catalytic Stimulus.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Catalytic Stimulus.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
Catalytic Stimulus.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Catalytic Stimulus.flavour: Invigorated by pain, the Emperor’s Children will embrace an enemy’s attack as a catalyst for masterful vengeance.

enhancements.name: Soulstain Made Manifest
enhancements.text: At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer; that unit must take a Battle‑shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Spiritsliver

enhancements.name: Tears of the Phoenix
enhancements.text: Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Weapon Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and Wound roll.

rule.name: Internal Rivalries
rule.text:
^^**Emperor's Children Character**^^ units from your army can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for them.

At the start of the battle, your **^^Warlord^^**'s unit is your army's Favoured Champions. The first time in each player's turn that an **^^Emperor's Children Character**^^ unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, after resolving all of its attacks, that **^^Character**^^ unit becomes your army's Favoured Champions, replacing the old one.

Each time a model in your army's Favoured Champions unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Devoted Duellists.name: DEVOTED DUELLISTS
Devoted Duellists.target: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
Devoted Duellists.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.
Devoted Duellists.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.
Devoted Duellists.flavour: By slaying theirfoes in close combat, the champions of Slaanesh seek to elevate themselves in his favour.

Beautiful Death.name: BEAUTIFUL DEATH
Beautiful Death.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Beautiful Death.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Beautiful Death.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Beautiful Death.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Beautiful Death.flavour: The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.

Heightened Jealousy.name: HEIGHTENED JEALOUSY
Heightened Jealousy.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
Heightened Jealousy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
Heightened Jealousy.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
Heightened Jealousy.flavour: Rivalries are commonplace amongst the champions of the Emperor's Children as all vie for Slaanesh’s boons.

Diabolic Majesty.name: DIABOLIC MAJESTY
Diabolic Majesty.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.

Diabolic Majesty.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Diabolic Majesty.flavour: Those who gaze upon one of Slaanesh’s chosen are stricken by their diabolic majesty.

Refusal to be Outdone.name: REFUSAL TO BE OUTDONE
Refusal to be Outdone.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.
Refusal to be Outdone.effect: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

Refusal to be Outdone.flavour: Rivals for the Dark Prince's favour will stop at nothing to outdo their foes and claim a greater tally of souls.

Vengeful Surge.name: VENGEFUL SURGE
Vengeful Surge.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.
Vengeful Surge.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.
Vengeful Surge.flavour: Consumed by their obsessive desire for revenge, the Emperor's Children surge into oncoming fusillades.

enhancements.name: Eager to Prove
enhancements.text: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.text: You can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for the bearer's unit. While the bearer's unit is your army's Favoured Champions, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Slayer of Champions
enhancements.text: The bearer's melee weapons have the [^^Precision^^] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a ^^**Character**^^ unit, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

rule.name: Quicksilver Grace
rule.text: You can re-roll Advance rolls made for **^^Emperor's Children^^** units from your army.

Violent Excess.name: VIOLENT EXCESS
Violent Excess.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

Violent Excess.flavour: The visceral thrill of killing causes the warriors of the Emperor’s Children to enter an ecstatic frenzy of butchery and dismemberment.

Combat Stimms.name: COMBAT STIMMS
Combat Stimms.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Combat Stimms.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Combat Stimms.flavour: Hideously euphoric concoctions empower the minds and constitutions of the Legion’s sybaritic warriors.

Honour the Prince.name: HONOUR THE PRINCE
Honour the Prince.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Honour the Prince.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Honour the Prince.flavour: Warriors who venerate Slaanesh through the most graceful fighting forms are rewarded for their efforts.

Dark Vigour.name: DARK VIGOUR
Dark Vigour.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Dark Vigour.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
Dark Vigour.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Dark Vigour.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Dark Vigour.flavour: The Emperor’s Children possess inhuman vigour- their warriors move with monstrous speed to counter any advance and meet any challenge.

Capricious Reactions.name: CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS
Capricious Reactions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Capricious Reactions.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

Capricious Reactions.flavour: Their superhuman reflexes enhanced by endless streams of addictive combat stimms, the Emperor's Children react to incoming fire with haste, weaving between shots and taking cover in the blink of an eye.

Cruel Raiders.name: CRUEL RAIDERS
Cruel Raiders.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Cruel Raiders.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.
Cruel Raiders.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Cruel Raiders.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Cruel Raiders.flavour: The Emperor's Children delight in the shattering of false hope, often disengaging from their foes only to strike again at an exposed flank.

enhancements.name: Steeped in Suffering
enhancements.text: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that target is also Below Half-Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Intoxicating Musk

enhancements.name: Tactical Perfection

enhancements.name: Loathsome Dexterity
enhancements.text: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Honour Is for Fools.name: HONOUR IS FOR FOOLS
Honour Is for Fools.when: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.
Honour Is for Fools.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
Honour Is for Fools.flavour: Far from facing enemy champions in fair duels one‑on‑one, the Flawless Blades fall upon them like a pack of jackals competing viciously to claim the glory of the kill.

Single-Minded Strike.name: SINGLE-MINDED STRIKE
Single-Minded Strike.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.
Single-Minded Strike.effect: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).
Single-Minded Strike.flavour: Scornfully dismissing the chaff that blocks their path, the Flawless Blades swat them aside and sweep regally on toward their true quarry.

Intoxicated by Triumph.name: INTOXICATED BY TRIUMPH
Intoxicated by Triumph.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Intoxicated by Triumph.flavour: Seeing their foes fleeing in terror before them only fires the chem‑laced blood of the Flawless Blades, urging them on toward their next challenge all the quicker.

Possessive Mania.name: POSSESSIVE MANIA
Possessive Mania.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective.

Possessive Mania.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Possessive Mania.flavour: Having seized some vital location or enthralling prize, these Slaaneshi warriors experience a frenzied need to claim it that renders them inured to the most grievous hurts.

Agonised Cacophony.name: AGONISED CACOPHONY
Agonised Cacophony.target: One friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
Agonised Cacophony.flavour: Hurling vile semiorganic screamer grenades into the midst of the foe, these warriors mark their presence not only by the wails of their ordnance, but also by the agonised screams of their victims.

Absolute Sensory Overload.name: ABSOLUTE SENSORY OVERLOAD
Absolute Sensory Overload.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to shoot.
Absolute Sensory Overload.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

EFFECT: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
Absolute Sensory Overload.flavour: Far from hiding from the foe, these warriors unleash such an unbearable barrage of blinding light and deafening sound that those who try to take aim at them are temporarily deafened and blinded.
