enhancements.text: This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

rule.name: Eager to Kill
rule.text: When a friendly **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR** unit is set up, that unit has +1 to **charge rolls** until the end of the turn.

Delight in Agony.name: DELIGHT IN AGONY
Delight in Agony.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
Delight in Agony.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Delight in Agony.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Delight in Agony.flavour: So well shielded by their armour are Emperor’s Children Terminators that, when the foe’s attacks actually punch through to wound them, the rarity of the sensation is an invigorating tonic.

Psychedelic Soulflame.name: PSYCHEDELIC SOULFLAME
Psychedelic Soulflame.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is selected to attack.
Psychedelic Soulflame.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have +2 S.
Psychedelic Soulflame.flavour: The Terminators’ fervid need to annihilate ever more enemies manifests as a lurid empyric firestorm which wreathes their blows and the projectiles spat from their guns.

Warp Plunge.name: WARP PLUNGE
Warp Plunge.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Warp Plunge.target: One friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
Warp Plunge.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
Warp Plunge.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
Warp Plunge.flavour: Addicted to the supreme danger of teleportation, these Terminators employ twisted warp sorcery to plunge into the immaterium time and again.

enhancements.name: Cacophonic Accompaniment
enhancements.text:
- This model has Deep Strike. 
- This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: - Frenzied FerocityUPGRADE
enhancements.text: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR SQUAD unit only. This unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rule.name: Musk of Torpidity
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Thrill Seekers ability lose that ability and gain this one.

This unit is eligible to perform a Tactical Manoeuvre in a turn in which it Fell Back or is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rule.name: Dark Radiance
rule.text: Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in that unit can move through friendly and enemy models.

Alluring Grotesquerie.name: ALLURING GROTESQUERIE
Alluring Grotesquerie.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
Alluring Grotesquerie.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Alluring Grotesquerie.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Alluring Grotesquerie.flavour: Physically and spiritually distorted by the blessings of Slaanesh, these warriors can project an aura that fascinates and revolts their enemies on a level so instinctual that it drives some to madness.

Cloying Corruption.name: CLOYING CORRUPTION
Cloying Corruption.target: One FLAWLESS BLADES unit from your army.
Cloying Corruption.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
Cloying Corruption.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One FLAWLESS BLADES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
Cloying Corruption.flavour: The mere presence of these Slaaneshi chosen is enough to taint the fabric of reality, saturating it with lingering spiritual corruption.

Eager for More.name: EAGER FOR MORE
Eager for More.when: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Eager for More.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Eager for More.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Eager for More.flavour: Never sated, no matter the ferocity of the fight, the Emperor's Children maintain a manic momentum as they drive toward their primary target at a breakneck pace.

Vying for Victory.name: VYING FOR VICTORY
Vying for Victory.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Vying for Victory.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Vying for Victory.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Vying for Victory.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Vying for Victory.flavour: Sweeping their enemies aside almost as an afterthought, these warriors press on with all haste, obsessed with staying ahead of their rivals within the boarding party.

enhancements.name: Venom of the Six-fanged Serpent
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 2.

enhancements.name: Daemonshrieker
enhancements.text: In your Shooting phase, you can select one closed Hatchway within 12" of and visible to the bearer. If you do, roll one D6: on a 2+, open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.

violentexcess.name: VIOLENT EXCESS
violentexcess.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
violentexcess.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
violentexcess.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
violentexcess.flavour: The visceral thrill of killing causes the warriors of the Emperor’s Children to enter an ecstatic frenzy of butchery and dismemberment.

combatstimms.name: COMBAT STIMMS
combatstimms.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
combatstimms.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
combatstimms.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
combatstimms.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
combatstimms.flavour: Hideously euphoric concoctions empower the minds and constitutions of the Legion’s sybaritic warriors.

honourtheprince.name: HONOUR THE PRINCE
honourtheprince.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
honourtheprince.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
honourtheprince.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
honourtheprince.flavour: Warriors who venerate Slaanesh through the most graceful fighting forms are rewarded for their efforts.

darkvigour.name: DARK VIGOUR
darkvigour.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
darkvigour.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
darkvigour.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
darkvigour.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (excluding BEASTS and VEHICLES) that is within 8" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
darkvigour.flavour: The Emperor’s Children possess inhuman vigour- their warriors move with monstrous speed to counter any advance and meet any challenge.

capriciousreactions.name: CAPRICIOUS REACTIONS
capriciousreactions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
capriciousreactions.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
capriciousreactions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
capriciousreactions.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
capriciousreactions.flavour: Their superhuman reflexes enhanced by endless streams of addictive combat stimms, the Emperor's Children react to incoming fire with haste, weaving between shots and taking cover in the blink of an eye.

cruelraiders.name: CRUEL RAIDERS
cruelraiders.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
cruelraiders.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.
cruelraiders.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
cruelraiders.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within 3" horizontally of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
cruelraiders.flavour: The Emperor's Children delight in the shattering of false hope, often disengaging from their foes only to strike again at an exposed flank.

deftparry.name: DEFT PARRY
deftparry.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
deftparry.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
deftparry.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
deftparry.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
deftparry.flavour: Bedazzled by these warriors’ weaving swordsmanship and hypnotic aura, foes cannot land a telling blow upon them.

deathecstasy.name: DEATH ECSTASY
deathecstasy.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
deathecstasy.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
deathecstasy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
deathecstasy.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
deathecstasy.flavour: Death is but another thrilling experience and the Emperor's Children are loath to deny the enemy such ecstatic sensation.

incessantviolence.name: INCESSANT VIOLENCE
incessantviolence.when: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.
incessantviolence.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
incessantviolence.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army Consolidates.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", provided your unit ends that Consolidation move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
incessantviolence.flavour: Caught up in the joyful exhilaration of violent excess, the momentum of the Emperor's Children is almost impossible to halt.

cruelbladesman.name: CRUEL BLADESMAN
cruelbladesman.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
cruelbladesman.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
cruelbladesman.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
cruelbladesman.flavour: Fulgrim’s scions are renowned for their bladecraft, toying with their inferiors while preparing an exquisite, penetrating thrust.

terrifyingspectacle.name: TERRIFYING SPECTACLE
terrifyingspectacle.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
terrifyingspectacle.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
terrifyingspectacle.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Command phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.
terrifyingspectacle.flavour: Flensing strikes, dismemberments and eviscerations strike fear into the hearts of the foe.

cutdowntheweak.name: CUT DOWN THE WEAK
cutdowntheweak.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
cutdowntheweak.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select a VEHICLE if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
cutdowntheweak.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.
cutdowntheweak.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army (you can only select a VEHICLE if it is a WALKER) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.
cutdowntheweak.flavour: Contempt for lesser warriors drives the Emperor's Children in their punishing reprisals.

ontothenext.name: ONTO THE NEXT
ontothenext.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
ontothenext.effect: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
ontothenext.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.

EFFECT: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
ontothenext.flavour: The fleeting obsessions of the Emperor's Children cause them always to seek fresh targets.

advanceandclaim.name: ADVANCE AND CLAIM
advanceandclaim.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
advanceandclaim.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
advanceandclaim.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that has one or more TORMENTORS units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
advanceandclaim.flavour: The Emperor's Children send forth their front-line troops in swift vehicles to seize ground rapidly.

dynamicbreakthrough.name: DYNAMIC BREAKTHROUGH
dynamicbreakthrough.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
dynamicbreakthrough.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
dynamicbreakthrough.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
dynamicbreakthrough.flavour: Relying upon shock, awe and daemonically enhanced vehicles, the Emperor's Children drive through the enemy lines to outflank the enemy.

ceaselessonslaught.name: CEASELESS ONSLAUGHT
ceaselessonslaught.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.
ceaselessonslaught.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
ceaselessonslaught.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this turn.

EFFECT: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
ceaselessonslaught.flavour: Cocktails of combat stimms and a blazing murderlust drive the warriors of the Emperor’s Children forward at breakneck speed.

reactivedisembarkation.name: REACTIVE DISEMBARKATION
reactivedisembarkation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
reactivedisembarkation.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
reactivedisembarkation.effect: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
reactivedisembarkation.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
reactivedisembarkation.flavour: As their transports come underfire, the Emperor’s Children disembark and take the fight to the foe with boltgun and sword.

outflankingstrike.name: OUTFLANKING STRIKE
outflankingstrike.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
outflankingstrike.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.
outflankingstrike.effect: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
outflankingstrike.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TRANSPORT from your army, or up to two EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DEDICATED TRANSPORTS from your army.

EFFECT: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
outflankingstrike.flavour: The Emperor’s Children utilise their infantry to pin the enemy down whilst further transports seek to outflank the foe and deploy troops behind.

sustainedbyagony.name: SUSTAINED BY AGONY
sustainedbyagony.when: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
sustainedbyagony.effect: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.
sustainedbyagony.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Select one friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit within 6" of your unit. One model in that LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit recovers up to 3 lost wounds or, if it is a DAEMONETTES unit, return upto D3+3 destroyed models to it instead.
sustainedbyagony.flavour: Slaaneshi daemons feed upon the emotions of others, with agony a particular delicacy.

ecstaticslaughter.name: ECSTATIC SLAUGHTER
ecstaticslaughter.when: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
ecstaticslaughter.target: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
ecstaticslaughter.effect: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.
ecstaticslaughter.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit and one friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of it that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit can declare a charge. If it does so and it has already been selected to fight this phase, it cannot fight again this phase.
ecstaticslaughter.flavour: As the violence intensifies, so does the ecstasy of battle empower daemon and mortal alike.

violentcrescendo.name: VIOLENT CRESCENDO
violentcrescendo.target: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
violentcrescendo.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
violentcrescendo.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One SLAANESH BEASTS, SLAANESH INFANTRY or SLAANESH MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". When doing so, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
violentcrescendo.flavour: In the final act of the battle, the followers of Slaanesh descend to slaughter the remaining foes.

sycophanticsurge.name: SYCOPHANTIC SURGE
sycophanticsurge.target: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.
sycophanticsurge.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.
sycophanticsurge.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, provided at least one of the targets of that charge is within Engagement Range of one or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units from your army.
sycophanticsurge.flavour: The daemons of Slaanesh care naught for mortals but strive to earn the approval of their Dark Prince.

uncannyreactions.name: UNCANNY REACTIONS
uncannyreactions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
uncannyreactions.target: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
uncannyreactions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
uncannyreactions.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SLAANESH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
uncannyreactions.flavour: Those who have earned the favour of their Dark Prince may be granted a sliver of his grace.

darkapparitions.name: DARK APPARITIONS
darkapparitions.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
darkapparitions.target: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
darkapparitions.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units.
darkapparitions.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One DAEMONETTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If it arrives back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units (instead of more than 8"), provided it is also set up wholly within 8" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units.
darkapparitions.flavour: The daemons of Slaanesh are not bound by the laws of reality, fading in and out of existence at will.

protectionofthedarkprince.name: PROTECTION OF THE DARK PRINCE
protectionofthedarkprince.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
protectionofthedarkprince.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
protectionofthedarkprince.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound or attack is allocated to a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
protectionofthedarkprince.flavour: On occasion, the Dark Prince may grant a boon of protection to his favoured followers in the heat of battle. Such a boon incurs a debt, one that will be paid in the fullness of time.

unshakeableopponents.name: UNSHAKEABLE OPPONENTS
unshakeableopponents.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
unshakeableopponents.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
unshakeableopponents.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll; the Wound roll.
unshakeableopponents.flavour: Inured to ordinary sensations by several lifetimes of indulgence, there is little that can deter or faze the warriors of the Emperor's Children.

embracethepain.name: EMBRACE THE PAIN
embracethepain.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.
embracethepain.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
embracethepain.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets, it must select your unit as the target of its attacks.
embracethepain.flavour: The Emperor’s Children revel in every sensation - even ones that would slay lesser mortals outright.

martialperfection.name: MARTIAL PERFECTION
martialperfection.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
martialperfection.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
martialperfection.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
martialperfection.flavour: The Emperor’s Children find stimulation in excess, be it brutally shocking acts of violence or gratuitous displays of martial prowess.

unboundarrogance.name: UNBOUND ARROGANCE
unboundarrogance.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
unboundarrogance.effect: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.
unboundarrogance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
unboundarrogance.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Increase your pledge to Slaanesh by 1.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
unboundarrogance.flavour: The hubris of the Emperor’s Children is both their greatest strength and their biggest weakness.

armourofabhorrence.name: ARMOUR OF ABHORRENCE
armourofabhorrence.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
armourofabhorrence.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
armourofabhorrence.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
armourofabhorrence.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
armourofabhorrence.flavour: The abhorrent contempt that the Emperor’s Children possess, combined with their combat-stimmed physiologies, makes them unyielding foes to face.

devotedduellists.name: DEVOTED DUELLISTS
devotedduellists.target: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
devotedduellists.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.
devotedduellists.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One or more EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.
devotedduellists.flavour: By slaying theirfoes in close combat, the champions of Slaanesh seek to elevate themselves in his favour.

beautifuldeath.name: BEAUTIFUL DEATH
beautifuldeath.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
beautifuldeath.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
beautifuldeath.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
beautifuldeath.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
beautifuldeath.flavour: The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.

heightenedjealousy.name: HEIGHTENED JEALOUSY
heightenedjealousy.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
heightenedjealousy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
heightenedjealousy.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
heightenedjealousy.flavour: Rivalries are commonplace amongst the champions of the Emperor's Children as all vie for Slaanesh’s boons.

diabolicmajesty.name: DIABOLIC MAJESTY
diabolicmajesty.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.
diabolicmajesty.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
diabolicmajesty.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
diabolicmajesty.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
diabolicmajesty.flavour: Those who gaze upon one of Slaanesh’s chosen are stricken by their diabolic majesty.

refusaltobeoutdone.name: REFUSAL TO BE OUTDONE
refusaltobeoutdone.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.
refusaltobeoutdone.effect: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.
refusaltobeoutdone.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.
refusaltobeoutdone.flavour: Rivals for the Dark Prince's favour will stop at nothing to outdo their foes and claim a greater tally of souls.

vengefulsurge.name: VENGEFUL SURGE
vengefulsurge.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.
vengefulsurge.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.
vengefulsurge.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.
vengefulsurge.flavour: Consumed by their obsessive desire for revenge, the Emperor's Children surge into oncoming fusillades.

contemptuousdisregard.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
contemptuousdisregard.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
contemptuousdisregard.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
contemptuousdisregard.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
contemptuousdisregard.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
contemptuousdisregard.flavour: With cocktails of resilience-enhancing stimms or armour inlaid with forbidden runes of warding, the Emperor’s Children sneeringly disregard even powerful blows.

pridefulsuperiority.name: PRIDEFUL SUPERIORITY
pridefulsuperiority.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
pridefulsuperiority.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
pridefulsuperiority.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
pridefulsuperiority.flavour: The chance to ostentatiously humble the foe’s champions and prove them worthless rivals is a lure few Emperor’s Children can resist.

sinuousbreach.name: SINUOUS BREACH
sinuousbreach.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
sinuousbreach.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
sinuousbreach.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
sinuousbreach.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
sinuousbreach.flavour: The power of Slaanesh is an undulating and writhing thing, and his daemonic servants can mould their forms to slither over and through any obstacle.

closequartersexcruciation.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS EXCRUCIATION
closequartersexcruciation.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
closequartersexcruciation.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
closequartersexcruciation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
closequartersexcruciation.flavour: At short range, the Emperor’s Children eagerly target weak points in their enemies, exulting over every cry of pain they elicit.

euphoricinspiration.name: EUPHORIC INSPIRATION
euphoricinspiration.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army.
euphoricinspiration.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units within 6" of your unit.
euphoricinspiration.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units within 6" of your unit.
euphoricinspiration.flavour: Those with the Dark Prince’s blessings inspire euphoric floods of battle-lust in the Emperor’s Children, who power towards the foe with screams of murderous ecstasy.

catalyticstimulus.name: CATALYTIC STIMULUS
catalyticstimulus.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
catalyticstimulus.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
catalyticstimulus.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
catalyticstimulus.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
catalyticstimulus.flavour: Invigorated by pain, the Emperor’s Children will embrace an enemy’s attack as a catalyst for masterful vengeance.

delightinagony.name: DELIGHT IN AGONY
delightinagony.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
delightinagony.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
delightinagony.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
delightinagony.flavour: So well shielded by their armour are Emperor’s Children Terminators that, when the foe’s attacks actually punch through to wound them, the rarity of the sensation is an invigorating tonic.

psychedelicsoulflame.name: PSYCHEDELIC SOULFLAME
psychedelicsoulflame.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is selected to attack.
psychedelicsoulflame.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have +2 S.
psychedelicsoulflame.flavour: The Terminators’ fervid need to annihilate ever more enemies manifests as a lurid empyric firestorm which wreathes their blows and the projectiles spat from their guns.

warpplunge.name: WARP PLUNGE
warpplunge.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
warpplunge.target: One friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.
warpplunge.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
warpplunge.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
warpplunge.flavour: Addicted to the supreme danger of teleportation, these Terminators employ twisted warp sorcery to plunge into the immaterium time and again.

possessivemania.name: POSSESSIVE MANIA
possessivemania.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective.
possessivemania.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
possessivemania.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
possessivemania.flavour: Having seized some vital location or enthralling prize, these Slaaneshi warriors experience a frenzied need to claim it that renders them inured to the most grievous hurts.

agonisedcacophony.name: AGONISED CACOPHONY
agonisedcacophony.target: One friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.
agonisedcacophony.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
agonisedcacophony.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
agonisedcacophony.flavour: Hurling vile semiorganic screamer grenades into the midst of the foe, these warriors mark their presence not only by the wails of their ordnance, but also by the agonised screams of their victims.

absolutesensoryoverload.name: ABSOLUTE SENSORY OVERLOAD
absolutesensoryoverload.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to shoot.
absolutesensoryoverload.effect: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
absolutesensoryoverload.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit.

EFFECT: Those ranged attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
absolutesensoryoverload.flavour: Far from hiding from the foe, these warriors unleash such an unbearable barrage of blinding light and deafening sound that those who try to take aim at them are temporarily deafened and blinded.

honourisforfools.name: HONOUR IS FOR FOOLS
honourisforfools.when: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.
honourisforfools.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
honourisforfools.flavour: Far from facing enemy champions in fair duels one‑on‑one, the Flawless Blades fall upon them like a pack of jackals competing viciously to claim the glory of the kill.

singlemindedstrike.name: SINGLE-MINDED STRIKE
singlemindedstrike.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.
singlemindedstrike.effect: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).
singlemindedstrike.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).
singlemindedstrike.flavour: Scornfully dismissing the chaff that blocks their path, the Flawless Blades swat them aside and sweep regally on toward their true quarry.

intoxicatedbytriumph.name: INTOXICATED BY TRIUMPH
intoxicatedbytriumph.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.
intoxicatedbytriumph.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
intoxicatedbytriumph.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
intoxicatedbytriumph.flavour: Seeing their foes fleeing in terror before them only fires the chem‑laced blood of the Flawless Blades, urging them on toward their next challenge all the quicker.

alluringgrotesquerie.name: ALLURING GROTESQUERIE
alluringgrotesquerie.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.
alluringgrotesquerie.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
alluringgrotesquerie.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
alluringgrotesquerie.flavour: Physically and spiritually distorted by the blessings of Slaanesh, these warriors can project an aura that fascinates and revolts their enemies on a level so instinctual that it drives some to madness.

cloyingcorruption.name: CLOYING CORRUPTION
cloyingcorruption.target: One FLAWLESS BLADES unit from your army.
cloyingcorruption.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
cloyingcorruption.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One FLAWLESS BLADES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker is Secured by your army.
cloyingcorruption.flavour: The mere presence of these Slaaneshi chosen is enough to taint the fabric of reality, saturating it with lingering spiritual corruption.

eagerformore.name: EAGER FOR MORE
eagerformore.when: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
eagerformore.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
eagerformore.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
eagerformore.flavour: Never sated, no matter the ferocity of the fight, the Emperor's Children maintain a manic momentum as they drive toward their primary target at a breakneck pace.

vyingforvictory.name: VYING FOR VICTORY
vyingforvictory.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
vyingforvictory.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
vyingforvictory.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
vyingforvictory.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.

TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
vyingforvictory.flavour: Sweeping their enemies aside almost as an afterthought, these warriors press on with all haste, obsessed with staying ahead of their rivals within the boarding party.
